label: Reduction Woodcut
intent: Graphic force, route clarity, and reliable thumbnail recognition
path_treatment: Build movement from directional gouge marks and a bold continuous carved rhythm.
form_treatment: Reduce subjects to high-contrast blocks, contour cuts, and one or two color anchors.
space_treatment: Reserve paper white for air and distance; remove gradients and incidental texture.
composition: Radically simplified hierarchy with one dominant path and a small unmistakable focal icon.
